## BoundedObservableCollection (generic arity 1)

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Ui.Services.Collections.BoundedObservableCollection</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Ui.Services/Collections/BoundedObservableCollection.cs:14](../../../../src/Meridian.Ui.Services/Collections/BoundedObservableCollection.cs#L14).

An observable collection optimized for prepending items with a fixed maximum size. Uses an internal deque pattern to achieve O(1) prepend operations instead of O(n) Insert(0). Thread-safe for single-threaded UI operations with proper change notifications.
